_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.english_concept: writing Slovak without diacritics — same habit as Romanian, opposite cultural stance and opposite tool ecology
phrases.register: describes informal typing; the discussion of it is neutral-to-critical
phrases.content_surface: faq, body — and as a rule governing the searched form of every other sk phrase
phrases.usage_guidance: Same standing rule as RO1: expect sk queries to arrive without diacritics ('ozdobne pismo na kopirovanie'), but publish sk/ copy with full correct diacritics. Do NOT build a diacritics-restoration feature off the back of this — that is a different product (corpus/NLP-backed), it is well served by academic and commercial Slovak tools already, and it is the opposite of this site's decorate-don't-normalise job.
phrases.good_example: Generátor funguje rovnako, či píšeš s diakritikou alebo bez nej.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not take a side on whether writing without diacritics is acceptable; and do not publish sk copy without diacritics.

phrases.english_concept: in-game handle — the colloquial loanword vs the native/official term
phrases.usage_guidance: Already in use — sk/pismo-pre-discord/ is titled 'písmená do nicku a bia'. Keep 'nick' as the player-facing word; reach for 'prezývka' when explaining a platform's own field label or writing anything policy-shaped, because that is the word the platform's Slovak UI will have used.
phrases.good_example: Skopíruj štýl a vlož ho do nicku — na Discorde sa zmení hneď.
phrases.avoid_when: Do not use 'nick' in a sentence about a platform's rules or an accessibility caveat; use 'prezývka' or 'meno' there.

phrases.usage_guidance: Useful for describing ONE recognizable nickname-generation pattern (anglicizing a real Slovak name) if SK generator copy ever explains different nickname styles/strategies.
phrases.avoid_when: Don't present as the ONLY nickname strategy — the same thread shows several other patterns (childhood nicknames, pet names, favourite numbers) with no single dominant native term.
